assessment: The study by Scinicariello et al. set out to identify novel factors that controlled TTP stability and identified HUWE1 by CRISPR screening in macrophages. HUWE1 limited TTP phosphorylation at later times post inflammatory stimulation on residues distinct from those functionally modified by MAPKs in early stages. Overall, the biochemical and cellular signaling experiments were thoughtfully designed and well executed, leading to the discovery of HUWE1 as a TTP regulator.
